snippet.title: Blades For Hire - Official Playtest Trailer | Dark Fantasy Mercenary Guild RPG
snippet.description:
Command your mercenary guild in a brutal dark fantasy world! ⚔️  
Sign up now for the BLADES FOR HIRE playtest — available on Steam.  

👉 PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE OPEN!  
Participate to earn exclusive armor & a two-handed sword upon full release.  
Playtests begin in Q1 2026!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180000/Blades_For_Hire/

#BladesForHire #RPG #TacticalRPG #DarkFantasy #IndieGame
